description: Feel2Real fixed read-only status (no writes, no restarts, no secret values). Section is restricted by allowedValues.

runCommand: systemctl show f2r-app.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p NRestarts -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p MemoryCurrent
[ -r /home/ec2-user/app.jar.meta ] && head -c 1024 /home/ec2-user/app.jar.meta | grep -E '^(git_sha|jar_sha256|deployed_at)=[A-Za-z0-9:.+-]{1,80}$' || echo "deploy marker app.jar.meta not present"
echo "oom_events_7d=$(journalctl -k --since '7 days ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -ciE 'out of memory|oom-kill')"
echo "===== flyway-history (SELECT only, READ ONLY session) ====="
# env 파일을 source하지 않는다(다른 비밀값을 export하거나 파일 내용을 실행하지 않도록 DB_* 다섯 키만 읽는다).
case "$k" in DB_HOST) DBH="$v";; DB_PORT) DBP="$v";; DB_USER) DBU="$v";; DB_NAME) DBN="$v";; DB_PASSWORD) DBW="$v";; esac
q() { MYSQL_PWD="$DBW" "${M[@]}" -e "SET SESSION TRANSACTION READ ONLY; $1" 2>/dev/null || echo "query_failed (detail suppressed)"; }
q "SELECT COUNT(*) AS applied, MAX(CAST(version AS UNSIGNED)) AS max_version, SUM(success=0) AS failed FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version IS NOT NULL;"
q "SELECT version, checksum, success, installed_on FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE CAST(version AS UNSIGNED) >= 1090 ORDER BY installed_rank;"
q "SELECT COUNT(*) AS studio_or_mcp_tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND (table_name LIKE 'studio\\_%' OR table_name LIKE 'mcp\\_%');"
echo "db settings missing or unexpected format (values not printed)"
unset DBW DBH DBU DBN DBP M
